# TextBlock

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A text block element that supports word wrapping, alignment, font customization, and automatic pagination across page boundaries.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `TextElementBase`. Implements `IRoleProvider`, `IStatefulElement`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new TextBlock(string text)
new TextBlock(params string[] lines)
new TextBlock(IEnumerable<string> lines)
```

## Properties

- [`Alignment`](#alignment): Paragraph alignment.
- [`Ellipsis`](#ellipsis): Ellipsis appended to the last line when `MaxLines` clamps.
- [`FirstLineIndent`](#firstlineindent): Paragraph layout: horizontal indent (points) applied to the first line of each paragraph (a paragraph = text between hard `\n` breaks).
- [`MaxLines`](#maxlines): Line clamp: maximum number of lines to render.
- [`MinLinesAfterBreak`](#minlinesafterbreak): Minimum number of lines that must appear after a page break (widow control).
- [`MinLinesBeforeBreak`](#minlinesbeforebreak): Minimum number of lines to render before a page break (orphan control).
- [`ParagraphSpacing`](#paragraphspacing): Paragraph layout: extra vertical space (points) inserted before each paragraph after the first.
- [`PreserveWhitespace`](#preservewhitespace): Keep every space, including leading and repeated ones, for text whose indentation carries meaning (source code, a fixed-width listing).
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): PDF/UA structure role for this element.

### `Alignment`

```csharp
TextAlignment Alignment { get; set; }
```

Paragraph alignment. When not set explicitly, an enclosing `Container` whose `HorizontalAlignment` is Start/Center/End supplies an ambient default instead of the plain Left below; see `EffectiveAlignment`.

### `Ellipsis`

```csharp
string Ellipsis { get; set; }
```

Ellipsis appended to the last line when `MaxLines` clamps. Default `…`.

### `FirstLineIndent`

```csharp
float FirstLineIndent { get; set; }
```

Paragraph layout: horizontal indent (points) applied to the first line of each paragraph (a paragraph = text between hard `\n` breaks). Default 0.

### `MaxLines`

```csharp
int? MaxLines { get; set; }
```

Line clamp: maximum number of lines to render. When set and the text wraps to more lines, the block is truncated to this many lines and `Ellipsis` is appended to the last visible line. Null = no clamp.

### `MinLinesAfterBreak`

```csharp
int MinLinesAfterBreak { get; set; }
```

Minimum number of lines that must appear after a page break (widow control). If fewer lines remain for the next page, the break point is adjusted to push more lines forward. Set to 1 to disable widow control. Default is 2.

### `MinLinesBeforeBreak`

```csharp
int MinLinesBeforeBreak { get; set; }
```

Minimum number of lines to render before a page break (orphan control). If fewer lines fit on the current page, the entire block moves to the next page. Set to 1 to disable orphan control. Default is 2.

### `ParagraphSpacing`

```csharp
float ParagraphSpacing { get; set; }
```

Paragraph layout: extra vertical space (points) inserted before each paragraph after the first. Default 0.

### `PreserveWhitespace`

```csharp
bool PreserveWhitespace { get; set; }
```

Keep every space, including leading and repeated ones, for text whose indentation carries meaning (source code, a fixed-width listing). Default `false`, which drops a segment's leading spaces.

Lines wrap by code point at the last space that fits, or mid-token when there is none, so a long line never overflows. Tabs are not expanded. Inherited by `Heading`; list items and `RichText` do not take it.

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

PDF/UA structure role for this element. Defaults to `P` (a paragraph). `Heading` overrides this to return one of `H1`…`H6`.

### `Text`

```csharp
string Text { get; set; }
```

The text to render. A hard line break starts a new paragraph.

## Methods

- [`RenderStateful`](#renderstateful): Renders this text block with state tracking for pagination.
- [`ResetState`](#resetstate): Resets the internal state, preparing the element for a fresh render.

### `RenderStateful`

```csharp
RenderStatus RenderStateful(RenderContext ctx, float width)
```

Renders this text block with state tracking for pagination. Text that doesn't fit on the current page will be continued on the next page. Respects MinLinesBeforeBreak (orphan) and MinLinesAfterBreak (widow) settings.

### `ResetState`

```csharp
void ResetState()
```

Resets the internal state, preparing the element for a fresh render.
